sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Hell on Earth - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "What's up, warrior. I've been talking to my nephew about some video game where you shoot demons. I thought I'd give him a little present. Anyway, here's the task: get me a double-barrelled shotgun like in that game, and make it look real nasty! Oh, and make the barrel shorter."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an MP-43-1C shotgun to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"It really is a beast! Even I'm now interested in seeing this game..."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Notes |
| MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun | 1 | Has to be modified and handed over | Can be purchased from Jaeger LL1. |
| MP-43-1C 12ga 510mm barrel | 1 | Has to be installed on the shotgun | Can be purchased from Jaeger LL1. |
In this quest you must hand over an MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun modified with the shorter MP-43-1C 12ga 510mm barrel to Prapor. Both items can be bought from Jaeger LL1.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: This questline is a reference to the game "Doom II: Hell on Earth" which features the "Super shotgun", a sawed-off, double-barreled shotgun.
